page.overview:
What is Raging Bolt?

Raging Bolt's design is very similar to Raikou, although more like a Sauropod. It is primarily yellow, with sharp black patterns along the sides of its long neck, body and legs. Its underside is white, lined with a bright orangish red accent. This color also is around its claws and eyes, its front legs have tufts of it before the claws. Its back has a jagged pattern marked in blue, and its lightning bolt shaped tail - with the tip shaped like a spike ball - has the same color and pattern as well. Its head is almost identical to Raikou's. What was originally a cape on Raikou resembles a storm cloud, which wraps around its head.

SV; Trade, as of version 3.0.0; None SV, TID; Area Zero; One

Sc; It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature. V; It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.
